 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Repeat the 4-row pattern above the solid zero separator below it.
    sep = next((i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(x == 0 for x in row)), len(grid))
    pattern = grid[:sep]
    if not pattern:
        return grid
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(sep + 1, len(grid)):
        out[r] = pattern[(r - sep - 1) % len(pattern)][:]
    return out
